decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the premise shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant shall not take place anywhere on the site except within building[s].
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times Midday to 11.00pm on weekdays and Saturdays and Midday to 9.00pm Sundays and Public Holidays].

Condition : 8 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times Midday to 11.00pm on weekdays and Saturdays and Midday to 9.00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 10 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.

Condition : 11 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant (A3 use) shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the restaurant and the residential flats above, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of use from Retail (A1) use to part Restaurant (A3) and part retail (A1)
